description: Every family of nonempty subsets of a common carrier indexed by a finite set has a function selecting a member of each subset. The index set may be empty.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.finite_choice.{u, v} {ι : Type u} {α : Type v} [Finite ι] (A : ι → Set α)
  (hA : ∀ (i : ι), (A i).Nonempty) : ∃ c, ∀ (i : ι), c i ∈ A i
